entities.summary: Robert Keith Horry is an American sports commentator and former professional basketball player who played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Houston Rockets, Phoenix Suns, Los Angeles Lakers, and San Antonio Spurs. Horry won seven NBA championships over his 16-year career and is considered to be one of the most clutch shooters in NBA history. He was given the nickname "Big Shot Rob" for making big shots in playoff games.
